biography: Kenny Habul, a name whispered with increasing reverence in Australian motorsport circles, hails from the sun-drenched Gold Coast. Unlike many drivers who were practically born in a go-kart, Kenny's journey began later, at age 16, during a corporate track day. He outperformed seasoned racers, leaving a lasting impression on a local team owner. He quickly progressed through the ranks of Formula Ford, showcasing a natural talent for car control and a remarkable ability to learn quickly. His defining moment came during the Queensland State Championships, where, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, he carved his way through the field to snatch victory on the final lap. Now racing for Mercedes-AMG, Habul is focused on making his mark in GT racing, showcasing the quiet determination that defines his character.
drivingStyle: Habul's driving style is characterized by its calculated aggression. He's not one for flamboyant displays or risky overtakes; instead, he meticulously studies his opponents, identifying their weaknesses and exploiting them with surgical precision. He's known for his exceptional tire management, often nursing his rubber to gain an advantage in the later stages of a race. His composure under pressure is remarkable, rarely cracking even in the most intense situations. This methodical approach, combined with innate car feel, makes him a formidable competitor.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their Formula Ford days, marked by several on-track collisions and accusations of unsportsmanlike conduct.

rivalries.name: Zara Petrova
rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and driving styles, with Petrova's aggressive, all-out approach contrasting sharply with Habul's calculated precision. This contrast has led to several tense battles on track.

rivalries.name: James O'Connell
rivalries.reason: A recent rivalry ignited by a controversial incident during the Bathurst 12 Hour, where O'Connell accused Habul of blocking him during a crucial qualifying lap.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks during every race weekend, regardless of the weather.
Listens to classical music before each race to calm his nerves and focus his mind.
Visually inspects every tire on his car before each session, no matter how rushed the schedule.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about bravado; it's about precision and control. The loudest driver isn't always the fastest.
careerHighlight: Winning the Queensland State Championships in Formula Ford after starting last, showcasing his exceptional overtaking skills and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the Bathurst 12 Hour in the final hour while leading, costing his team a potential victory.
